Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Sign Reading 15.4.1 Intensive sign reading: Poems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 15.4.1 Intensive sign reading: Poems, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to relate ideas read in works of art to real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 15.4.1 Intensive sign reading: Poems together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem: interpretation and inference skills as learners read poems and relate the ideas in the poem to

real life.

• Communication and collaboration: teamwork skill when the learners discuss the meaning of poems in groups.

Values:
Patriotism: learners read poems on tourist attraction sites and appreciate the role they play in the country.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life Skills -Effective communication: learners discuss the meaning of the selected poems in groups.

• Education for Sustainable Development: learners read given grade appropriate on tourist attraction sites (world).
